description: Router agent as a single graph-backed multi-asset per case — ReAct steps are ops visible in the run view; per-branch outputs are separate downstream assets. Only branches the classifier picks are emitted per partition, so downstream lineage stays honest (a voucher-sink only shows partitions for cases that actually issued a voucher).

outputs.description: One asset per declared `outputs:` entry, each carrying the trajectory + summary + n_iterations in metadata.

asset_name.label: Asset Name
asset_name.description: Base name for the router graph (used in op naming). Emitted assets are the `outputs:` names below.

upstream_asset_key.label: Upstream Asset Key
upstream_asset_key.description: Upstream asset providing the per-case DataFrame. Filtered by partition_static_column to a single row per partition.

task_template.label: Task Template
task_template.description: The task template the planner sees for each case. Row column names substitute via .format() — e.g. 'Resolve for {passenger} on {flight}'. {partition_key} also available.

tools.label: Tools
tools.description: Bounded list of tools the planner can pick from at each step. Each entry has {name, description, system_message}.

outputs.label: Outputs
outputs.description: Downstream branches. Each entry becomes its own Dagster asset. Emitted per-partition only when the classifier picks it. Each: {name, description, kinds}.

max_iterations.label: Max Iterations
max_iterations.description: Max ReAct steps (= number of plan_step ops in the graph).

model.label: Model
model.description: OpenAI-compatible chat model. Same model powers planner + tools + classifier by default.

api_key_env_var.label: API Key Env Var
api_key_env_var.description: Env var holding the LLM API key.

api_base_env_var.label: API Base Env Var
api_base_env_var.description: Env var holding an OpenAI-compatible base URL (Vercel AI Gateway, local Ollama, etc.).

temperature.label: Temperature
temperature.description: Lower is better for tool-picking discipline.

planner_max_tokens.label: Planner Max Tokens
planner_max_tokens.description: Max tokens for each planner turn.

tool_max_tokens.label: Tool Max Tokens
tool_max_tokens.description: Max tokens for each tool LLM response.

classifier_max_tokens.label: Classifier Max Tokens
classifier_max_tokens.description: Max tokens for the final classifier response.

classifier_system_message.label: Classifier System Message
classifier_system_message.description: Optional override for the classifier's system prompt.

partition_static_column.label: Partition Static Column
partition_static_column.description: Upstream column to filter on for the current partition (e.g. 'case_id' with partition_values 'c1,c2,c3').
